# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This project is maintained in spare time. Security updates are provided on a best-effort basis.

Currently supported:
- Latest version on the default branch

Older versions may not receive security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions.

Instead, report privately via expostudio.contact+security@gmail.com

Please include:
- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce (proof of concept if possible)
- Affected version/commit
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix (optional)

## What to Expect

As a solo maintainer, I will respond as quickly as possible, but response times may vary.

Best effort targets:
- Initial acknowledgment: within **7 days**
- Status update after triage: within **14 days**

If the report is accepted, I will work on a fix and coordinate disclosure timing with you when possible.

Thank you for helping keep this project and its users safe 🙏
